title: Exogenous RNA surveillance by proton-sensing TRIM25
model: HCT116, Brunello KO library, LNP-delivered GFP mRNA (unmodified or N1m-pseudouridine), GFP FACS sort
contrast: Unmodified mRNA, GFP top 2.5% vs unsorted input (2 vs 2); also GFP bottom 2.5% and N1m mRNA
paper_method: Not stated in accessible text (supplement paywalled)
paper_calls: HSPGs and V-ATPase mediate uptake and escape; TRIM25 (with N4BP1, KHNYN, ZAP) suppresses exogenous mRNA
barcs_calls: 2 genes at FDR 0.10 in GFP-high (TRIM25, N4BP1); 24 in GFP-low (V-ATPase, SLC35B2, EXTL3)
named_hits: TRIM25 #1 and N4BP1 #2 (FDR 0.003, 0.053); V-ATPase and HSPG genes top the GFP-low bins; KHNYN and ZAP not called alone
verdict: BARCS reproduces the screen's main findings: TRIM25 and N4BP1 suppress unmodified but not N1m mRNA, and V-ATPase and heparan-sulfate synthesis genes are needed for LNP-mRNA expression.
count_recovery: Raw reads = (normalized - 1) / (one scale factor per sample); integrality 100.0%.
